profile.headline:
Senior Software Engineer Manager
People‑Centric Leadership | Engineering Enablement | Modernization, SDLC & AI‑Driven Productivity
profile.summary:
Senior engineering leader with deep experience enabling enterprise‑wide software delivery across Supply Chain and Technology Enablement portfolios. I specialize in engineering enablement, modernization, and operational excellence — helping teams deliver high‑quality software consistently, reliably, and at scale.



  



I’ve led multi‑team engineering organizations (up to 89 engineers across managers, associates, and global contractors) and supported more than 50 applications across diverse stacks including cloud‑native, SaaS, packaged software, custom development, and legacy systems. My focus is on building strong engineering foundations: SDLC standards, CI/CD, observability, automation, resiliency, and developer experience.



  



Skilled at communicating across organizational levels and functions, influencing decisions, and aligning engineering, product, architecture, security, platform, and business stakeholders. I thrive in matrixed environments where success depends on influence, partnership, and cross‑functional execution.



  



My leadership style is people‑centric and development‑focused. I build inclusive, high‑performing cultures through coaching, clear expectations, and shared ownership. I’ve consistently achieved 90%+ leadership scores while improving system reliability, reducing incidents by 36% YoY, and enabling teams to absorb 35% unplanned work without sacrificing delivery.



  



Focus Areas:

 • Engineering Enablement & CoE Leadership

 • SDLC Standards, CI/CD, Observability, Automation

 • Modernization & Cloud Adoption (GCP, PCF)

 • Resource Planning & Capacity Management

 • Cross‑Functional Delivery in Matrixed Enterprises

 • Operational Excellence & System Reliability

 • Talent Development & Inclusive Leadership

 • Cloud‑Native, SaaS & Legacy Systems



  



I’m passionate about helping engineering teams gain momentum, solve complex problems, and deliver outcomes that matter — through clarity, structure, and a culture of continuous improvement.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer Manager
positions.description:
Senior engineering leader driving modernization, engineering enablement, and operational excellence across Supply Chain and Technology Enablement portfolios. Most recently led two engineering teams supporting Inventory Planning & Replenishment (IPR), which forecasts and replenishes domestic and import inventory, flowing inventory daily to 2,300 stores and 100+ SDCs/DFCs/BDCs/FDCs and transloads. Partnered with two senior managers, seven managers, 14 product teams, Reliability Engineering, and business support teams to reduce KTLO, manage IT and business escalations, and improve systemic health and stability across 60+ IPR applications.



 



Led multi‑team organizations (3 managers, 26 engineers, and 55 global contractors) with consistent 90%+ leadership scores. Strengthened engineering foundations through SDLC standards, CI/CD, observability, automation, resiliency, and AI‑driven productivity. Delivered measurable outcomes including a 36% YoY incident reduction, 1500+ hours saved through automation and GenAI‑supported analysis, and the ability to absorb 35% unplanned work without sacrificing delivery.



 



Drove adoption of GCP, microservices, CI/CD, observability, and agile practices across enablement teams. Improved reliability and delivery throughput through deep analysis, modernization, and AI‑supported remediation. Championed GenAI for reporting, documentation, research, and development workflows to reduce maintenance costs and accelerate decision‑making.



 



Orchestrated quarterly product roadmaps and executive readouts, aligning engineering execution with enterprise strategy and business priorities. Partnered with Product, UX, Architecture, Security, Platform, RE, and Supply Chain business teams to deliver integrated solutions. Supported enterprise test initiatives with environments, labs, and performance/functional testing capabilities. Managed vendor contracts, labor and cloud/hardware budgets, and end‑to‑end testing coordination.

positions.title: Software Engineer Manager
positions.description:
Engineering manager leading four software engineering teams across Supply Chain and Merchandising portfolios, driving application development, quality, automation, and modernization initiatives. Oversaw day‑to‑day engineering execution across front‑end, back‑end, and test automation teams while building high‑performing, collaborative cultures through coaching, mentoring, and clear expectations.

 

Led teams of up to 36 onshore associates and contractors and 11 offshore contractors, delivering key growth initiatives and KTLO work across multiple product experiences. Partnered closely with Product, Architecture, and Engineering leaders to improve delivery efficiency, strengthen engineering practices, and advance modernization efforts.

 

Guided engineers through career development, pairing, and challenging assignments to build technical depth and leadership capability. Recruited and retained high‑potential talent through strong partnerships with Talent Acquisition and vendor teams. Mentored teams through modernization and agile adoption, improving collaboration, delivery flow, and engineering maturity.

 

Led the transition of Quality Software Engineers to full‑stack practices using Java and Python for test frameworks and application code. Directed activities across 19 engineering teams to achieve 80%+ test automation, improving reliability and reducing manual effort. Reduced costs by eliminating licensed tools and physical servers through open‑source adoption and custom solutions.

 

Partnered with engineering leaders in monthly reviews of organizational goals and metrics to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement. Built and promoted a Quality Dashboard to standardize measures and improve visibility for engineering and product teams. Supported delivery of key initiatives by prioritizing engineering work, resolving technical challenges, and improving quality practices.

positions.title: Lead QA Analyst
positions.description: Led QA efforts across multiple supply chain and retail applications, improving test coverage, defect detection, and release quality. Partnered with engineering and product teams to define test strategies, streamline validation processes, and support major production releases. Contributed to early automation and quality‑engineering practices that informed later modernization work.

positions.title: Manager
positions.description: Managed QA and support teams responsible for validating customer‑facing applications and ensuring stable releases across high‑volume environments. Improved team workflows, strengthened cross‑functional communication, and introduced structured quality processes that reduced defects and improved delivery consistency.

positions.title: QA Analyst
positions.description: Supported testing and release readiness for large‑scale telecom applications. Led test planning, execution, and defect management while collaborating with engineering and business teams to improve product stability and user experience.

positions.title: QA Lead
positions.description: Supported testing and release readiness for large‑scale telecom applications. Led test planning, execution, and defect management while collaborating with engineering and business teams to improve product stability and user experience.

positions.title: QA Analyst
positions.description: Executed functional and regression testing for payroll and HR systems, contributing to reliable product releases and improved customer satisfaction.
